svg.text: PROJECT 3 | CIRCULAR BUFFER / REGISTERED READ + DATA HOLD
ADDRESS / CONTROL — WA and RA connect to the matching memory pins above
Invalid delay: RA = WA; output valid = 0; hold Q.
Named nets WA, RA, range_ok, oData, iClk and iRsn join pins with the same name. Dots mark connected branches.
All register resets are asynchronous and active low. Data memory is not reset; valid bits prevent stale data from becoming valid.
Read behavior: clocked output captures pre-edge memory values; DEPTH delay follows read-before-write RTL semantics.
Source-derived RTL structure. Not a post-synthesis FPGA technology netlist; no physical resource count is claimed.
